canonical_title: AU Room Reservation: Smart Room Reservation Management for University
abstract: The purpose of the AU Room Reservation System is to manage booking details such as booking details and room details because we discovered that the university used paper for faculty admin to book rooms, but it was quite difficult for students to book rooms for any study or project discussion, but the AU reservation system makes it easy for staff to manage room reservation management system via the web application. Room and booking information can be easily recorded, checked, created, modified, and deleted by staff. AU Room Reservation is the smart room reservation management system for Assumption university. It is used to manage and reserve a room in the university which it uses instead of paper-based reservation. For user platform, it is mainly focused on the student via the iOS and kiosk application. For the staff platform, there is a web application that staff can manage such as creating new rooms, setting rooms, or deleting rooms. Staff also can check the reservation history and manage the admin accounts via this application.

canonical_title: AU TOKEN: Smart Tokens for Assumption University Using Blockchain
abstract:
Students have an explicit goal in mind when studying. Even so, they are probably lost toward the destination. Besides, they sometimes lose motivation for some subjects or do not fully enjoy the student life due to the excessive focus on the goal. From the institution's perspective, recruiting the staff for some activities is also challenging if students are not wholeheartedly joyful. With all the spotted problems, the virtual currencies that can incentivize students to put more effort and act as a sub-goal to regain the motivation are tremendously necessary.

AU Token, known as ATK, is an education application built on Hyperledger Fabric to establish the infrastructure of permissioned blockchain. It aims to provide the virtual currencies system and serve as a foundation for further applications. ATK has two tokens: Academic token, known as ACA, and lifestyle token, known as LIF. These two can be used to purchase the privilege capable of improving student life experience using the ATK for Student in iOS platform to interact with the blockchain. To fulfill the transparency and trustworthy characteristics, ATK provides ATK Explorer to display transactions happening in the system. Furthermore, for ease of governing, ATK provides ATK Admin to the concerned party of the university to manage the privileges and token distribution.

abstract: In this project, after the camera is connected and recognized, we collect the skeleton point data through OpenPose and compare it with the data of the standard action x. If the difference between the user's skeleton point data and the data of the standard action x is not large, it is determined to be successful and counted successfully. If there is a large gap between the user's skeleton point data and the standard action x's data, it will be judged as failure and the failure will be counted. Users can choose the one they want to try among the 4 sports, enter the target success count, and display the success count and failure count after completing the success counts.
